en: Dependent on a state that is an object of clinging (*upādāna*), a state that is not an object of clinging arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are nine; ... [and so on] ...
under the resultant condition (*vipāka*) there is one; ... [and so on] ... under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are nine.
